editorial:
Imagine waking up every single night and reliving your worst nightmare. That is exactly what happens to Cathy, a woman who gets attacked in her own home. She cannot get the memory out of her head, so she goes to a special sleep clinic to find a cure. The vibe is very tense and creepy because you never know if what she is seeing is a dream or real life. You will feel her panic as she tries to figure out who is targeting her and why she cannot escape these scary visions.

The acting is solid and really makes you feel for the main character. The way the plot unfolds is slow at first, but it picks up as the mystery gets deeper. One downside is that some of the 80s effects look a bit dated now, but the suspense still works great. If you love psychological thrillers, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch, or if you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: You find out that the doctor helping Cathy was actually the one manipulating her dreams all along. He used the sleep research to mess with her mind and control her. In the end, Cathy realizes she is being played and has to fight back against him to survive. She eventually escapes his grasp, breaking the cycle of nightmares and finding a way to finally wake up from the trap he set for her.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological puzzles and sleep-related horror.
